summary: Runs npm run cad:benchmark bundled by Vite, as the application is built, instead of through tsx, whose name-keeping wrappers made the medians of the same drag previews 5 to 12% slower in one run against each of two bundled runs. Each report records its runner, and a solver-workloads run directory refuses parts from another runner. A preview group runs only the drag previews, which now also cover 32 sketches, and each preview reports one full parse of a copy of the prepared document and that document's JSON size. The new baseline shows that a preview's preparation grows with the document rather than the edit: at 32 sketches it takes about 52 ms, three 60 Hz frames, and one full parse takes 94 to 95% of that while the solver calls take under 0.5 ms. No application code changes.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Benchmark reports from before 0.0.761 were measured through tsx and are not comparable with bundled reports; compare only reports with the same runner.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD, storage, journal or worker reply change. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. WebMCP tools keep their arguments and result fields.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change and no new application controls.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change.
checklist.verification: Two bundled preview runs of 30 samples and one through tsx at 1, 4, 8 and 32 sketches; a quick bundled run of every group, including the cold solver probes started from the bundle; the full Vitest suite, lint, ui:check, build and the release check.

changes: No visible change. The CAD performance benchmark now measures the code as the application runs it.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged.
